name: twist
description: The farmer twists the conversation completely: leaves a booking for a registration or the other way round, changes animal and problem in one message, asks something unrelated or off-topic, says only hello / thanks / ok / 'hmm', gives a bare 'yes' at a wrong moment, cancels and asks in one message, changes language, changes his mind about the date again and again, comes back to an old booking, corrects the bot, or drops a registration and asks about that animal. 30 per language. Bookings and registrations never get the final 'yes', so nothing is saved.
facts_note: Same farm as layers 1-3 (f-001): goat 14, buffalo 16 (Mehsana 5, Nili-Ravi 5), sheep 7, chicken 7, cow 9 (Kankrej 3), total 53. GAURI and MOTI = Sirohi goats, KAALI = Jamunapari goat, LAKSHMI = Murrah buffalo, BIJLI = Nili-Ravi buffalo, RAJA = Kankrej cow, CHINNI exists. BHOORI does NOT exist. Dates use placeholders counted from now in IST (see evals/run.py).
